title: Social Security (International Agreements) Act 1999
converter: cth_convert_sym_v10.py (a copy of docx_text() of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py that also maps Symbol-font and private-use characters; kept outside the repository); the first deposit used harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py (workbench)

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.previous_converter: harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py (docx_text), the converter of the 2026-10-13 deposit
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word documents of C2026C00397, volumes 1 and 2 (download_sha256 0e97e37fe5cc5d976cd5ac0edf7ae77aa738b0d9d16781df590905dd8d1d11da, unchanged)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: The Word documents type some list bullets in the Symbol font as the private-use code point U+F0B7, which docx_text() kept as is, so they displayed as empty boxes. cth_convert_sym_v10.py maps private-use code points U+F0xx and Symbol-font w:sym elements to Unicode (F0B7 •, F0B4 ×, F0A3 ≤, F0B3 ≥ and the like) and Wingdings boxes to "[ ]"; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: A diff against the first deposit shows only these 8 lines changed (same 8,346 lines and 1,083,928 characters: each private-use U+F0B7 became the bullet U+2022): lines 855-856 and 859-861 (Australia's interpretative declaration on Article 5(1) of the New Zealand Agreement: the bulleted lists of what the Agreement enables and of the provisions of the Act it affects) and lines 5548-5550 (Article 12(5) of the Agreement with Greece: the bulleted list of payments under the legislation of Hellas to be disregarded).
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.encodings_affected: none (the subject has no encodings); the formulas sidecar C2004A00564.formulas.md quotes none of the changed lines and its line references are unchanged
